query: My car was clamped in a private car park and the company wants a release fee. I am in England. I want to know if this is legal and who helps.
title: My car was clamped or towed from private land: who helps

freeHelp.title: POPLA — Parking on Private Land Appeals
freeHelp.blurb: Free independent appeal for private parking charge notices after the operator rejects your first appeal (BPA operators). Online appeal; phone support available.

freeHelp.title: Independent Appeals Service (IAS)
freeHelp.blurb: Free standard appeal for private parking charges from International Parking Community (IPC) accredited operators. Appeals are online / in writing.

freeHelp.title: Resolver — private parking tickets guide
freeHelp.blurb: Free step-by-step guide to challenging private parking tickets, including when to use POPLA or IAS.

freeHelp.title: Traffic Penalty Tribunal
freeHelp.blurb: Free independent appeal for council parking and traffic PCNs in England (outside London) and Wales — after the council rejects your representations.

freeHelp.title: London Tribunals (Environment & Traffic Adjudicators)
freeHelp.blurb: Free independent appeal for London council / TfL parking and traffic PCNs after a Notice of Rejection. Online portal; phone for hearing queries.

freeHelp.title: Citizens Advice Adviceline (England)
freeHelp.blurb: Free phone advice on consumer, debt, housing, employment and more — routes to local help.
